ayat.arabic: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرࣱ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ ۝٥٨
ayat.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “In Allah’s grace and mercy let them rejoice. That is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass.”

ayat.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٤
ayat.translation: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,

ayat.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ۝١٥
ayat.translation: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَفِيضُوا۟ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ ۝١٩٩
ayat.translation: Then go forth with the rest of the pilgrims. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ۝٢٠١
ayat.translation: Yet there are others who say, “Our Lord! Grant us the good of this world and the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.”

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝١
ayat.translation: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness.

ayat.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝٢
ayat.translation: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ ۝٣
ayat.translation: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١
ayat.translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝٢
ayat.translation: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?

ayat.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرࣲ ۝٣
ayat.translation: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.

ayat.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرࣲ ۝٤
ayat.translation: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۝٥
ayat.translation: It is all peace until the break of dawn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ ۝٣
ayat.translation: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٨٣
ayat.translation: O believers! Fasting is prescribed for you—as it was for those before you—so perhaps you will become mindful ˹of Allah˺.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ ۝١٨٦
ayat.translation: When My servants ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about Me: I am truly near. I respond to one’s prayer when they call upon Me. So let them respond ˹with obedience˺ to Me and believe in Me, perhaps they will be guided ˹to the Right Way˺.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١
ayat.translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.

ayat.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرࣲ ۝٣
ayat.translation: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.

occasions.name: The Ten Days of Dhul Hijjah

ayat.arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ ۝١
ayat.translation: By the dawn,

ayat.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرࣲ ۝٢
ayat.translation: and the ten nights,

ayat.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِي ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالࣰا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرࣲ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقࣲ ۝٢٧
ayat.translation: Call ˹all˺ people to the pilgrimage. They will come to you on foot and on every lean camel from every distant path,

ayat.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ ۝٦٢
ayat.translation: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”

ayat.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقࣲ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٦٣
ayat.translation: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain.

ayat.arabic: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةࣰ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدࣰا ۝١٠
ayat.translation: ˹Remember˺ when those youths took refuge in the cave, and said, “Our Lord! Grant us mercy from Yourself and guide us rightly through our ordeal.”

ayat.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَاۜ ۝١
ayat.translation: All praise is for Allah Who has revealed the Book to His servant, allowing no crookedness in it,
